reason: The hypothesis makes specific mechanistic claims about grain boundaries, energy barriers, and their effects on transition width and hysteresis, but cites no prior evidence to support any of these premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover these specific structure-property relationships in FeMnNiGeSi-type high-entropy alloys.
premises: Grain boundaries act as heterogeneous nucleation sites for the magnetostructural transition
Increased nucleation site density lowers the energy barrier for the transition
Lowering the energy barrier broadens the transition and reduces hysteresis
